abilities.name: Commander
abilities.text: Treat this Unit's Supply characteristic as increased by 1 for Controlling and Contesting Mission Markers, completing objectives, and resolving Disengage checks.

abilities.name: Plague Warden
abilities.text: Treat the Supply characteristic of any Enemy Unit that has the INFESTATION Status and is Within 6″ as reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0) for Controlling and Contesting Mission Markers, and completing objectives.

abilities.name: Spread Infestation
abilities.text: Target an Enemy Unit Within 8″. The targeted Unit gains the INFESTATION Status. For the purposes of resolving Special Abilities, this effect is treated as a DEBUFF.

abilities.name: Admiral of the Infested
abilities.text: Target an Enemy Unit Within 8″ that has the INFESTATION Status. That Unit counts as Activated in this Phase (set an Activation Marker next to it) and remove the INFESTATION Status from that Unit. You may target any Non-Unique Infested Friendly Unit that is Within 8″ of the previously targeted Enemy Unit. Remove the Activation Marker from that targeted Friendly Unit.

abilities.name: Bio-Kill Switch
abilities.text: Each Enemy Unit with the INFESTATION Status on the battlefield suffers Damage (2). Immediately after this Special Ability is resolved, remove the INFESTATION Status from Units that suffered Damage.

abilities.name: Corrode Armor
abilities.text: Immediately after this Unit resolves a Ranged Attack against an Enemy Unit, the targeted Unit suffers the DEBUFF Armour (1).

abilities.name: Devastating Charge
abilities.text: Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge, resolve the IMPACT (6) 4+ effect.
